### Checklist

- [ ] I started from the sample (`scripts/contrib/new_usecase.py`) and kept the folder layout.
- [ ] `python scripts/contrib/validate.py` passes locally.
- [ ] I bumped `version` and added a `changelog` entry (for updates to an existing use case).
- [ ] I ran the brief end to end in the workshop and the generated app works.
- [ ] Images are png, jpg or webp, under 1 MB, and I have the right to share them.
- [ ] The brief contains no secrets, customer data, or links to non-https sites.
- [ ] New contributor only: I added my `/contrib/usecases/<id>/` line to `.github/CODEOWNERS`.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
